title: PROPOSAL FOR COMPREHENSIVE POST-CONSTRUCTION DEEP CLEANING AND FUMIGATION SERVICES
raw_input:
# PROPOSAL FOR COMPREHENSIVE POST-CONSTRUCTION DEEP CLEANING AND FUMIGATION SERVICES

## SUBMITTED BY

# KAMIBRIX LIMITED

**Professional Cleaning • Fumigation • Pest Control**

---

# 1. INTRODUCTION

KAMIBRIX LIMITED is pleased to submit this proposal for the provision of comprehensive Post-Construction Deep Cleaning and Fumigation Services for the property.

Our objective is to deliver a thorough, professional and detailed cleaning service that will transform the property into a clean, hygienic, dust-free and move-in-ready environment. The project will involve the removal of construction dust, cement residues, paint splashes, grout stains, debris and other post-construction contaminants.

Upon completion of the cleaning exercise, comprehensive fumigation and pest-control treatment shall also be carried out across the entire property.

---

# 2. SCOPE OF WORK

The project covers the comprehensive cleaning and fumigation of the following areas:

## A. MAIN RESIDENTIAL BUILDING

### 1. Sitting Room and Toilet

* Comprehensive cleaning of the sitting room.
* Cleaning of floors, walls and accessible surfaces.
* Cleaning of windows, doors and fittings.
* Removal of construction dust and debris.
* Deep cleaning and sanitization of the attached toilet.

### 2. Kitchen and Store

* Deep cleaning of the kitchen.
* Cleaning of cabinets, countertops and accessible surfaces.
* Cleaning of sinks and wall tiles.
* Removal of construction dust and residue.
* Comprehensive cleaning of the store area.

### 3. Three (3) Bedrooms with En-suite Toilets

The scope covers:

* Deep cleaning of three (3) bedrooms.
* Cleaning of floors, windows, doors and accessible surfaces.
* Removal of construction dust and debris.
* Cleaning of wardrobes and fittings where applicable.
* Deep cleaning and sanitization of the three (3) attached toilets.

### 4. Master's Bedroom

* Comprehensive deep cleaning of the Master's Bedroom.
* Cleaning of floors, walls and accessible surfaces.
* Cleaning of windows, doors and fittings.
* Removal of construction dust and post-construction residues.
* Detailed finishing and preparation of the room for occupancy.

### 5. Family Lounge, Toilet, Walk-in Closet and Balcony

The scope covers:

* Comprehensive cleaning of the family lounge.
* Cleaning of the attached toilet.
* Detailed cleaning of the walk-in closet.
* Cleaning of wardrobes and accessible shelving.
* Washing and detailing of the balcony.
* Removal of dust, debris and construction residues from all accessible surfaces.

---

## B. BOYS' QUARTERS

The Boys' Quarters consists of:

* One (1) Sitting Room.
* One (1) Bedroom.
* One (1) Toilet.
* One (1) Kitchen.

The scope shall include comprehensive post-construction deep cleaning of all areas, including:

* Floors and accessible surfaces.
* Doors and windows.
* Kitchen fittings and surfaces.
* Bedroom and sitting room.
* Toilet and sanitary fittings.
* Removal of construction dust, debris and residues.

---

# 3. COMPREHENSIVE POST-CONSTRUCTION DEEP CLEANING SERVICES

The cleaning service shall include, but not be limited to:

* Removal of construction dust from all accessible surfaces.
* Sweeping and industrial vacuuming of floors.
* Removal of construction debris and accumulated dirt.
* Removal of removable cement, grout, paint and silicone residues where appropriate.
* Machine scrubbing of suitable floor surfaces.
* Cleaning and polishing of tiles.
* Cleaning of walls, skirting areas and accessible corners.
* Cleaning of doors, door frames and handles.
* Cleaning of windows, window frames and sliding tracks.
* Cleaning of wardrobes and accessible storage areas.
* Deep cleaning and sanitization of toilets and bathrooms.
* Intensive cleaning of kitchen cabinets, sinks and countertops.
* Cleaning of bedrooms and living areas.
* Cleaning of the walk-in closet.
* Balcony washing and detailing.
* Cleaning of switches, light fittings and accessible electrical accessories.
* Final detailing and finishing of the entire property.

---

# 4. COMPREHENSIVE FUMIGATION AND PEST CONTROL

Upon completion of the post-construction cleaning exercise, KAMIBRIX LIMITED shall carry out comprehensive fumigation and pest-control treatment of the entire building.

The fumigation shall cover:

* All bedrooms.
* Sitting rooms and family lounge.
* Kitchens and store areas.
* Toilets and bathrooms.
* Walk-in closet.
* Balcony areas.
* Boys' Quarters.
* Relevant pest-prone areas.
* Accessible external and perimeter areas where applicable.

## Fumigation Treatment Includes:

* Treatment against cockroaches.
* Treatment against ants.
* Treatment against spiders.
* Mosquito control.
* General crawling-insect control.
* Treatment of common household pests.
* Residual pest-control treatment where appropriate.
* Post-treatment guidance on ventilation and safe re-entry.

---

# 5. AMAC-CERTIFIED FUMIGATION SERVICES

KAMIBRIX LIMITED is an AMAC-certified fumigation service provider.

Upon satisfactory completion of the fumigation exercise, the applicable AMAC fumigation/service certificate shall be issued as documentation of the completed fumigation service.

---

# 6. PROJECT COST SUMMARY

| DESCRIPTION                                                     |   AMOUNT (₦) |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | -----------: |
| Comprehensive Post-Construction Deep Cleaning – Entire Property |     ₦500,000 |
| Comprehensive Fumigation & Pest Control – Entire Property       |     ₦250,000 |
| **GRAND TOTAL**                                                 | **₦750,000** |

# GRAND TOTAL: ₦750,000

### Amount in Words: Seven Hundred and Fifty Thousand Naira Only.

---

# 7. EQUIPMENT AND MATERIALS TO BE DEPLOYED

To ensure efficient and professional execution of the project, KAMIBRIX LIMITED shall deploy appropriate industrial-grade equipment and cleaning materials, including:

## Industrial Equipment

* Industrial Wet and Dry Vacuum Cleaner.
* Floor Scrubbing Machine.
* High-Pressure Washer.
* Floor Polishing Equipment.
* Steam Cleaning Equipment where required.
* Other necessary professional cleaning equipment.

## Cleaning Tools and Materials

* Industrial Mops.
* Heavy-Duty Scrubbing Brushes.
* Microfiber Cloths.
* Floor Squeegees.
* Paint Scrapers.
* Grout-Cleaning Brushes.
* Buckets and Cleaning Accessories.

## Cleaning Chemicals

* Heavy-Duty Degreasers.
* Cement and Grout Removers.
* Tile Cleaning Solutions.
* Glass Cleaners.
* Multi-Surface Disinfectants.
* Toilet Descalers.
* Sanitizing Agents.
* Professional Pest-Control Chemicals.

---

# 8. HEALTH, SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE

KAMIBRIX LIMITED is committed to maintaining high standards of health, safety and environmental responsibility throughout the project.

All personnel assigned to the project shall utilize appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and follow established safety procedures while handling equipment, machinery and cleaning chemicals.

Appropriate safety precautions shall also be observed during the fumigation exercise, including proper preparation of treatment areas and the provision of ventilation and safe re-entry instructions.

---

# 9. PROJECT DURATION

## Estimated Completion Period: 1–2 Working Days

The actual duration may vary depending on the condition of the property, accessibility, availability of water and electricity, level of construction residue and other site-specific conditions.

---

# 10. TERMS AND CONDITIONS

1. This quotation covers only the areas and services specifically stated in this proposal.

2. Any additional area or service not included in the agreed scope may attract an additional charge.

3. The quoted price is based on the scope of work and property configuration provided.

4. Prices may be reviewed where there are significant changes to the agreed scope, site conditions or accessibility.

5. Personal belongings, food items, sensitive equipment and valuables should be properly secured before fumigation.

6. Occupants should vacate areas scheduled for fumigation as advised by the fumigation team.

7. The property should be adequately ventilated after fumigation before re-entry.

8. All services shall be carried out using appropriate professional methods, equipment and materials.

9. A final inspection shall be conducted upon completion of the project.

---

# PREPARED BY

## KAMIBRIX LIMITED

**Professional Cleaning • Fumigation • Pest Control**

**Email:** [kamibrix@gmail.com](mailto:kamibrix@gmail.com)
